item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 27/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A relatively humid easterly airstream will gradually affect the coast of southern China this week. The weather will be cloudier with a few mist patches over the region and it will be mild during the day.

Date/Month: 27/02 (Sunday)
Wind: Light winds force 2, becoming east force 3 to 4.
Weather: Fine. Cool in the morning. Dry during the day. Visibility relatively low in some areas.
Temp range: 15 - 21 C
R.H. range: 60 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 28/02 (Monday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny intervals.
Temp range: 16 - 21 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 01/03 (Tuesday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain and mist patches. It will be mild.
Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 02/03 (Wednesday)
Wind: Northeast force 3 to 4.
Weather: One or two mist patches in the morning. Sunny periods in the afternoon.
Temp range: 17 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 03/03 (Thursday)
Wind: East force 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy. One or two light rain patches in the morning and at night.
Temp range: 17 - 20 C
R.H. range: 70 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 04/03 (Friday)
Wind: East force 2 to 3.
Weather: Sunny intervals. Some mist in the morning and at night. It will be mild.
Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 05/03 (Saturday)
Wind: East force 3 to 4.
Weather: Sunny intervals. One or two light rain and mist patches in the morning and at night. It will be mild.
Temp range: 18 - 22 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 06/03 (Sunday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4, occasionally force 5.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with one or two rain patches.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low

Date/Month: 07/03 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 4.
Weather: Sunny intervals.
Temp range: 16 - 19 C
R.H. range: 75 - 90 per Cent
PSR: Low

Sea surface temperature at 2 P.M. 26/02/2022 at North Point was 17 degrees C.
Soil temperatures at 7 A.M. 26/02/2022 at Hong Kong Observatory :
0.5 M below surface was 18.2 degrees C
1.0 M below surface was 19.9 degrees C
